 TX Longhorns still hoping for BR flight 
 By WAFB Staff Published : Nov. 13, 2026 at 9:22 PM CST | Updated : 23 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google BATON ROUGE, La. (WAFB) - The Texas Longhorns football team is hoping to be able to fly into Baton Rouge late Friday evening, Ross Dellenger of Yahoo Sports reported.
 One source told WAFB the team was expected to arrive in Baton Rouge by midnight.
 They are set to take on LSU at Tiger Stadium at 6:30pm Saturday.
 The team’s plane was prevented from taking off from Austin Friday afternoon after the FAA ordered a nationwide ground stop. That stop has now been lifted.
